arguments.explanation: Flags transactions whose amount is negative and below -$300, which the request calls refunds of more than $300.
assumptions: Amounts are in US cents, so -$300 is -30000 and 'below -$300' means strictly less than -30000.
You called negative amounts 'refunds'. The database does not document what negative amounts mean, so the rule flags them by sign and size only.
The rule applies to all transaction types and all dates in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31).
